currentRoundInspection.scope: One full exterior and one vault detail plus ordinary viewer PMTiles/DEM; no bespoke sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.author: Goudarz.memar
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×658 exterior facing Maqsura iwan: tall blue/pale pointed facade, deep pointed vault, paired tiled cylindrical minarets with projecting polygonal balconies and smaller upper stages, turquoise dome behind; two-tier pointed courtyard fields. Fine inscriptions, floral/diamond artwork, lanterns, furniture, crowds and fountain not copied.

pictures.author: Dr.rezaei 13
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×355 detail of muqarnas/painted vault. It supports a coarse faceted pointed soffit treatment only; it is not an exterior plan or dome-height control. Fine cells, floral art and exact geometric pattern are omitted.
